crossRefs.note: Moses said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,
Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for…
He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of…
By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”
translations.bsb: “As you say,” Moses replied, “I will never see your face again.”
translations.kjv: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again
translations.asv: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well. I will see thy face again no more.
